properties.name: awskotlin.s3.endpoint
properties.description: Override the S3 endpoint URL (for example, a LocalStack endpoint). Falls back to awskotlin.endpoint.

properties.name: awskotlin.s3.region
properties.description: Override the S3 region. Falls back to awskotlin.region, then the SDK default region chain.

properties.name: awskotlin.s3.path-style-access-enabled
properties.description: Force path-style bucket addressing. Defaults to true when an endpoint override is configured, false otherwise.
